title: PeerReceiptArgs.at field accepted but silently discarded — no comment
description: ReceiptHandler parses PeerReceiptArgs which includes an 'at: String' field (RFC 3339 timestamp from the peer). The field is fully parsed but never referenced in the success path — delivered_at and read_at are populated from the local clock (now_unix). This is correct per CLAUDE.md (peer timestamps are untrusted), but there is no comment explaining the intentional discard. A contributor seeing the unused field will either try to use it (wrong) or remove it (may break protocol compatibility). — Add a comment on the at field or in the success path explaining: 'peer-supplied timestamp is accepted for protocol compatibility but discarded; local clock is used for delivered_at/read_at per the defensive input policy'.
